Name: Cuter Morris
Author: scrotorrr
Description:
I don't know how to replace the portraits using Content Patcher (replacing portraits in mods that already replace Vanilla portraits is outside my wheelhouse).  But I do know that I wanted a cuter Morris to Marry in my Joja run to make it a little less painful.  So I had the dear and talented Medisun make some portraits and sprites for him that I copied and pasted into the respective SVE and Marry Morris folders.

I separated the portraits into 2 main folders in this download.  One for SVE and one for Marry Morris.  I very carefully deleted Morris's portraits and sprites in the original mods mods and replaced them with the ones in my "mod."

SVE:
Portraits found in Stardew Valley Expanded>[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded>assets>CharacterFiles>Portraits>Morris
Sprites found in Stardew Valley Expanded>[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded>assets>CharacterFiles>OverworldSprites>Morris

Marry Morris:
Portraits and sprites found in Marry Morris>[CP] Marry Morris>assets>Portraits

I hope you like these as much as I do <3

Special thanks to Medisun for making these for me and for the amazing Skell for giving me pointers on adding a scarf and gloves.  I hope I did them proud :)

**NOTE, in my Joja playthrough, I saw that there is a Morris in icons that needs replaced, as well as the portrait once you're married.  Workin on this asap!**
